$comment: UPDATE PASS 2026-09-30, git 6837462. Supersedes the homepage-only IA (committed at 486e41d). Re-derived directly from src/routes.jsx, src/pages/*, src/components/**, content/blog/*.json and content/case-studies/*.json — every route and section id below is a real match/data-section attribute in the codebase, not a plan. Motion-4 (blog/case-study hover polish) and Phase 2 QA are still in progress at this revision; neither changes routes, sections, or templates, so this IA does not need to wait for them. Order = DOM order in each page component.

meta.source: https://www.transform9.com/ (full site; see ROUTES.md). Pages on external domains are excluded per PROJECT_SCOPE.md.
meta.evidence: CLONE_SPEC.md + specs/*.md (live measurement, 2026-09-30); QA_REPORT.md, recon/audit-pages-1/AUDIT.md, recon/audit-pages-2/AUDIT.md

categories.SHELL: Chrome present across many or all routes: navigation, mobile menu, background layers, preloader, popup, footer.
categories.HERO: Page-opening header block: a headline, and where the template has one, a primary call to action or form.
categories.PROOF: Homepage-only social proof: client logos, case-study spotlight, metrics, testimonials.
categories.PRODUCT: Homepage-only product explanation and its four agent modules.
categories.TRANSITION: Scroll-scrubbed pixel-grid transitions between dark and light surfaces, shared by templates that carry a dark/white split.
categories.FIT: Homepage-only buyer-fit content: specialties, EMR integrations, security/compliance.
categories.CONVERSION: Closing call-to-action block, reused across every marketing and content template.
categories.LEGAL: Legal template content (Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, HIPAA).
categories.CONTENT: Blog and case-study index and detail content, data-driven from content/*.json.

shell.page-layers.description: Fixed background layers behind page content: tiled noise overlay and solid background on every route, plus a looping hero video (with a still-image fallback under reduced motion) on templates that show one.
shell.page-layers.scope: Present on all 18 routes; the video is omitted on the 10 blog-post and case-study routes.

shell.navbar.description: Fixed 60px top bar with a blurred translucent dark background: logo, primary links, Login, green Book a Demo button. Tweens to a white treatment while a white section (home, /compare) is under it.

shell.mobile-menu.description: Full-screen overlay menu opened from the burger at ≤991px: large nav links, Login and Book a Demo bar; stops smooth scroll while open.
shell.mobile-menu.scope: Present on all 18 routes (visible at tablet/mobile widths only).

shell.preloader.description: Fixed full-screen black overlay shown until the page-load intro fades it out.
shell.preloader.scope: Present on 16 routes: /compare, the 3 legal routes, /blog, the 8 blog posts, /case-studies, and the 2 case studies. Absent on home and /book-a-demo.

shell.bg-pixels-overlay.description: Fixed full-screen overlay that dims and undims the background video during the /compare page-load intro.

shell.call-alex-modal.description: Hidden fixed 'Call Alex' popup with name/email/phone form, client-side validation and success/error states (no network); opened from a page's 'Call Alex' link(s).

shell.footer.description: Footer top: rail with company description, Navigate/Legal/Social link columns and an email signup form (static, no network).
shell.footer.scope: Present on 17 routes; /book-a-demo shows only shell.footer-bottom-reveal (no top footer, no email form).

shell.footer-bottom-reveal.description: Sticky bottom bar revealed beneath the page as it scrolls away: oversized wordmark and legal link row.

hero.home.description: Full-viewport dark hero over the fixed video: 6.5vw headline 'Maximize Every Call with a Custom AI Agent', a 'Who We Are' statement, and a 'Test Our AI Agent' phone input plus 'Call Alex' link.
hero.home.scope: Present only on the homepage (1 route).

hero.compare.description: Full-viewport dark hero for /compare: headline, supporting paragraph and the same 'Call Alex' / phone-input CTA row pattern as the homepage hero.

hero.legal.description: Hero for the legal template: H1 plus an intro paragraph over the fixed video, shared verbatim by all three legal routes with only the H1/intro content varying.
hero.legal.scope: Present on the 3 legal routes (Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, HIPAA).

hero.book-a-demo.description: Split hero for /book-a-demo: green H1 and supporting copy on the left; the 5-field booking form (visible white labels per D12, client-side validation, static success block, no network per D2/D9) on the right. This is the whole page.

hero.blog-index.description: Word-by-word animated H1 (8 words) plus the featured-post card, above the article list.

hero.case-studies-index.description: Word-by-word animated H1 (6 words) for the case-studies index; no featured item.

proof.client-logos.description: Continuously scrolling marquee of client practice logos between hairlines.
proof.client-logos.scope: Present only on the homepage (1 route).

proof.client-spotlight.description: Case-study spotlight heading ('Client Spotlight – Andrews Sports Medicine') with a click-to-load YouTube facade.
proof.client-spotlight.scope: Present only on the homepage (1 route).

proof.stats.description: Four metric blocks in blue tints: hover expands a block and reveals its image on desktop; click accordion at ≤991.
proof.stats.scope: Present only on the homepage (1 route).

proof.testimonials.description: Testimonial slider: photo block, quote, author with green title badge, practice logo, numbered prev/next arrows with cross-fade.
proof.testimonials.scope: Present only on the homepage (1 route).

product.how-it-works.description: Scroll-stepped 'How it works' sequence where three large phrases highlight one at a time.
product.how-it-works.scope: Present only on the homepage (1 route).

product.scheduling-agent.description: Agent #1 Scheduling: sticky card deck where earlier cards scale down, lift and tint as later cards scroll in.
product.scheduling-agent.scope: Present only on the homepage (1 route).

product.tasking-agent.description: Agent #2 Tasking: 200vh half-split with auto-rotating vertical tabs (4s progress bar) and fading image panes; click tabs at ≤991.
product.tasking-agent.scope: Present only on the homepage (1 route).

product.navigator-agent.description: Agent #3 Navigator: four row tabs activated on hover, with the matching image in the left rail.
product.navigator-agent.scope: Present only on the homepage (1 route).

product.outreach-agent.description: Agent #4 Outreach: sticky left title panel with five sticky stacking cards in blue tints on the right.
product.outreach-agent.scope: Present only on the homepage (1 route).

transition.black-to-white.description: Scroll-scrubbed pixel-grid transition from the dark page into a white section.

transition.white-to-black.description: Scroll-scrubbed pixel-grid transition from a white section back to the dark page.

fit.specialties.description: 'Designed for Your Specialty': 13 hover-activated specialty tabs with a matching image pane, plus 'And other specialties'.
fit.specialties.scope: Present only on the homepage (1 route).

fit.integrations.description: 'Built to Connect': EMR/partner logos in two opposing marquee rows with hover background and logo swap; marketplace links open externally.
fit.integrations.scope: Present only on the homepage (1 route).

fit.security.description: 'Secure. Compliant. Trusted.': image rail and a 2×2 grid of certification cells with hover background and logo swap.
fit.security.scope: Present only on the homepage (1 route).

conversion.cta.description: Closing CTA over a background image revealed by a scroll-scrubbed pixel grid: agent list, 'Quick Start / Live in 60 Days', large headline, phone input with 'Call Alex' and 'Book a Demo'.
conversion.cta.scope: Present on 14 routes: home, /compare, /blog, the 8 blog posts, /case-studies and the 2 case studies. Absent on /book-a-demo and the 3 legal routes.

compare.generic.description: 'Not Generic Call Center AI' claim section: image rail plus a headline and body paragraph.

compare.comparison-table.description: Static 10-row feature-comparison table against competitors; the Transform9 column is tinted. Header row is sticky at ≤767 (top 60, blurred).

compare.access.description: 'Built for Real Patient Access': a 5vw heading (fixed size at every width, including 390) over two workflow-claim blocks.

compare.specialty-white.description: White-background variant of the homepage specialty tabs (fit.specialties), reinforcing specialty fit inside the comparison narrative.

compare.integrations-white.description: White-background variant of the homepage integration marquees (fit.integrations), with a green (not black) hover treatment.

compare.privacy.description: Privacy & Security claim blocks with a hover state (background lightens on the hovered block only).

compare.evaluation.description: 'Healthcare AI Evaluation': a four-item accordion (Webflow tabs used as an accordion; click activates, exactly one item open, arrow/Home/End keyboard support).

legal.content.description: Rich-text legal body: intro-paragraph style, green sub-heads, bullet lists and inline links (rel="noopener" per D10). One component, three content variants (Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, HIPAA) driven by src/data/legal/*.js.

content.blog-list.description: Post-grid ('All Articles') list with a description line and a 'Load More' control that appends the remaining posts client-side, then hides itself; no network request (D14).

content.case-list.description: Case-study card grid; no featured item and no pagination (all items shown at once).

content.post-header.description: Blog-post detail header: back link, hero image, title, and author/date meta points.

content.case-header.description: Case-study detail header: back link, client-logo panel with a divider, title, and a data-driven highlight-quote or two-stat block (only the populated variant renders).

content.post-body.description: Rich-text article body rendered from structured content blocks (h1/h2/h3/p/ul/ol/blockquote, inline bold/italic/links), one hairline per body slot after the first, with a sticky share column (X/Facebook/LinkedIn icons, inert per D13).
content.post-body.scope: Present on the 8 blog-post and 2 case-study routes.

content.read-next.description: Single related-case-study card at the foot of a case study. The equivalent block on blog posts is hidden on the live site and is not rendered.
